name: reasoning-steps-aria-lucide
title: Reasoning Steps (React Aria, Lucide)
description: A collapsible reasoning trace for AI replies: a shimmering trigger label with a self-timing readout, steps that pop from a dot into a check, nested details and source pills, and the active step announced to screen readers.
author: Edwin Vakayil <https://github.com/edwinvakayil>
docs:
Installed `ReasoningSteps` and its parts (`@/components/ui/reasoning-steps`).

```tsx
import {
  ReasoningStep,
  ReasoningSteps,
  ReasoningStepsContent,
  ReasoningStepsTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/reasoning-steps";

<ReasoningSteps>
  <ReasoningStepsTrigger>Reasoning</ReasoningStepsTrigger>
  <ReasoningStepsContent>
    <ReasoningStep label="Reading the request" status="done" />
    <ReasoningStep label="Drafting the answer" status="active" />
  </ReasoningStepsContent>
</ReasoningSteps>
```

Render one `ReasoningStep` per step as your model reports progress: mark the current one `active` and flip it to `done` when the next starts. Leave future steps out (or `pending`). Colors come from your theme tokens (`card`, `foreground`, `muted-foreground`, `ring`).

Ported from Reasoning Steps in Iconiq by Edwin Vakayil (MIT); the license notice is at the end of the file.
